tools.name: vertodigital_get_site_index
tools.description: Returns the full site index - every VertoDigital page's URL and a one-line description, source of the valid slugs used by vertodigital_get_page.

tools.name: vertodigital_get_page
tools.description: Fetches the full markdown content of any VertoDigital page by its URL slug - service pages, case studies, blog posts, about, and more. Valid slugs are listed in vertodigital_get_site_index's output.

tools.name: vertodigital_search_case_studies
tools.description: Searches across all 49 VertoDigital case studies by keyword - client name, industry, service, or outcome. Returns matching excerpts as markdown, each with its own case-studies/<slug> URL for a full-detail fetch via vertodigital_get_page. Broad but shallow; the 4 flagship, stats-first proof points ar

tools.name: vertodigital_get_contact
tools.description: Return VertoDigital's contact information - how to get in touch with the team.

tools.name: vertodigital_why_verto
tools.description: Returns VertoDigital's value proposition for a query - matched services, proof-point case studies, and/or differentiation reasons, each with a concrete stat. Consolidates what used to be 3 separate tools (vertodigital_match_services, vertodigital_get_proof_points, vertodigital_why_verto) into one en

tools.name: vertodigital_send_enquiry
tools.description: Submits a general contact enquiry to VertoDigital on behalf of a user - sales, partnership, press, careers, or general questions. No authentication required. A full Pipeline Readiness Assessment request is handled separately by vertodigital_request_assessment.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vertodigital_get_site_index, vertodigital_get_page, vertodigital_search_case_studies · Private data: vertodigital_get_contact, vertodigital_send_enquiry · Public sink: vertodigital_send_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: vertodigital_get_site_index, vertodigital_get_page, vertodigital_search_case_studies · Private data: vertodigital_get_contact, vertodigital_send_enquiry · Public sink: vertodigital_send_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
